title: Integer/Cardinal bitwise AND
rationale: Model-drafted by local qwen3-coder:30b from measured FPC evidence: `and` on integer operands is a bitwise AND over the two's-complement bits (12 and 10 = 8; -1 and 255 = 255), matching Rust's integer `&`; gate-validated and oracle-proven on signed (incl. negative) and unsigned cases.
